name: jev-workflows
description: Jev classification for tools, models, tasks and arbitrary decisions, with evidence review and automatic Codex lifecycle consultation.

interface.longDescription: Compare available tools, models, tasks, skills and strategies using TypeSafe Jev. Evaluate typed questions together, preserve task context, diagnose command failures, review completion evidence and record observed outcomes. Optional local hooks provide advisory consultation; returned judgments never grant permissions or prove an action succeeded.
